Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in the final comparison step. While correctly identifying the birth dates (Reginald Le Borg: 1902, Hervé Bromberger: 1918), the Planner incorrectly concluded that the film with the older director (Le Borg, born 1902) had the "younger" director. The logic was reversed: since 1902 is earlier than 1918, Le Borg is older, meaning the film directed by Bromberger (Figaro-Ci, Figaro-L) has the younger director. The Planner stated "Joe Palooka in Fighting Mad has the younger director" based on the premise that Bromberger was "about 54" and Le Borg was "about 46" at the time of their respective films, but failed to correctly map the birth year comparison to the final answer. The question asks which film's director is younger (in absolute age), not which was younger at the time of the film's release. Even if interpreted as age at release, the calculation in the reasoning was flawed because it compared ages at different times (1948 vs 1972) without normalizing to a common reference point, leading to the wrong conclusion.
